item.title: Setting Up a Development Environment with Windows 11, WSL2 and Docker
item.author: hari@dasarpai.com (Dr. Hari Thapliyaal)
item.description:
Setting Development Environment with WSL2, Docker and Github
#

This guide sets up a data-science-friendly dev stack on Windows 11. Install in this order:

  1. Windows 11 — use a PC that meets the Windows 11 requirements. Turn on CPU virtualization in firmware (BIOS/UEFI) if you will run Docker with WSL2.
  2. WSL2 — open PowerShell as Administrator, run wsl --install, reboot, then run wsl --set-default-version 2.
  3. Ubuntu — install Ubuntu from the Microsoft Store, launch it once, and create your Linux username and password.
  4. Docker Desktop — install Docker Desktop for Windows, enable the WSL2 backend, and under Settings → Resources → WSL Integration, turn on integration for your Ubuntu distro.

The sections below expand each step (WSL2, Docker, VS Code, GitHub).

item.title: Exploring the Local Location of Ollama Models on WSL2
item.author: hari@dasarpai.com (Dr. Hari Thapliyaal)
item.description:
Exploring the Location of Ollama Models on Local Machine
#

Ollama stores each model as files in a folder. On the Linux service in this article, that folder was /usr/share/ollama/.ollama/models. A copy you install for your own user often uses the home folder instead.

Linux and WSL, your user: ~/.ollama/models
Linux service on this machine: /usr/share/ollama/.ollama/models
Windows: C:\Users\<username>\.ollama\models

~ is your home directory. On this WSL machine that is /home/hari.

item.title: Decoding Windows User Folder
item.author: hari@dasarpai.com (Dr. Hari Thapliyaal)
item.description:
Decoding Windows User Folder
#

C:\Users holds a few fixed folders plus one folder per person.

Folder What Windows puts there
Default The template copied when a new user is created
The named user That person’s files and settings
Public Files every account on this PC can open
AppData\Local Cache and data that stay on this PC
AppData\Roaming Settings that follow the user to another PC on the same domain

My machine c:\users folder has 3 users Detault, harip, public. What is the purpose of these 3 users?
#

The C:\Users folder on a Windows machine contains subfolders for each user profile on the system. Here’s an explanation of the purpose of the three users you mentioned: Default, hari, and Public.

item.title: Linux OS Directories
item.author: hari@dasarpai.com (Dr. Hari Thapliyaal)
item.description:
Linux OS Directories
#

Linux OS Folders and the purpose.

Introduction:
#

Linux is a widely used operating system that is known for its flexibility and versatility. One of the unique features of Linux is its file system hierarchy, which is organized into a many directories that serve specific purposes. Folder structure of Unix OS and all distributions of Linux is same. Each directory has its own set of files and subdirectories that are used to manage various aspects of the operating system and data folders.
